_readme.what: How-To Guides — first-hand procedural knowledge for the tenant library's How-To section.
_readme.who: Entries are written from Brad's first-hand experience. Each guide is a real procedure that has actually been done, not theory.
_readme.how_to_add_an_entry: Copy the '_entry_template' object into 'guides', give it a new id, fill the fields, set status to 'published' when ready. Entries with any other status are hidden from the app.

fields.title: plain-language title — what the person is trying to do
fields.summary: one or two sentences — what this guide gets them
fields.steps: ordered list; each step has a short 'title' and a 'body' explaining what to actually do
fields.tips: optional list of things learned the hard way — what to watch for
fields.related_subjects: library subjects this guide relates to (see taxonomy.py ALL_SUBJECTS)
fields.source: 'first_hand' for Brad's experience; anything else needs a note
fields.status: 'placeholder' = skeleton only, hidden | 'draft' = written, hidden | 'published' = shown

_entry_template.title: How to ___ (replace with the real task)
_entry_template.summary: What this gets done and why it matters, in one or two sentences.

steps.title: First thing you do
steps.body: What to actually do — the real-world version, including where to go, what to bring, what to say.

tips: Things that went wrong or surprised you — what you'd tell a friend doing this for the first time.
